notes.title: The Beek Original Soundtrack is Out Now
notes.content:
The Beek: How I Became a Familiar Spirit and Everything After That - Original Soundtrack by Rhett Lee features arrangements of dynamic music tracks from the game. 

Both MP3 and high-quality FLAC versions of all tracks from the game are available for download. Relive your time chatting with Beek with this melodious score! (Demon powers not guaranteed.)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678550/Beek_Familiar_Spirit__Original_Soundtrack/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53463/Beek__Original_Soundtrack_Bundle/

Save 10% off the soundtrack for the first week, and save further by using the bundle if you already own the game!

- From the team at Studio Klondike

notes.title: Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered v2.1
notes.content:
Just days after release, a new update to Beek is here. This update aims to address some of the immediate player feedback with some improvements to the game mechanics!

For the detailed list of changes implemented with Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered v2.1, please read on below.

- From the team at Studio Klondike

Bookmarks Menu[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/24a90d181e21d94711aafe156b7e0a4d69494cb3.png

The Bookmark limit has been increased from 4 to 12. Bookmarks now also indicate the last message received, along with displaying icons for the current route. (Veeph, Akro, and Bramir)

Message Skip Tutorial[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/e3a86c7426c73f2f0b8810558f395872f8e6ccea.png

A new tutorial indicator has been added to help teach the player how to skip previously seen text. This indicator will disappear after the player has clicked the message skip button.

Fast Mode[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/8158d7da0edd946da3f03ed22de638b9b0871acf.png

A Fast Mode button has been added to the Settings. While active, the game will progress at 5x speed. This may be particularly useful on a second playthrough.

Additional Changes[hr][/hr]
 A bug that caused a soft-lock on Day 4 has been resolved.

notes.title: Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/cf98458fdd3c1b23cb685bdda390f37768d8d05a.png
Beek: How I Became a Familiar Spirit and Everything After That returns, now better than ever! The furry texting adventure isekai— rebuilt with updated gameplay mechanics, updated game engine, and a new English script.

Rebuilt from the ground up![hr][/hr]
With this Remastered project our team wanted to ensure that Beek remains playable long into the future. We remade the game from scratch on an updated game engine, adding heaps of quality of life features and tweaks along the way.

A messaging app connecting you to another world.[hr][/hr]
The Steam release of Beek features an immersive interface, with tweaks to the real-time elements from the original game to make it possible to play in a continuous session.

We hope that this remaster gives new and returning players an even better chance to experience Beek! 

- From the team at Studio Klondike



It’s a promise... one day we'll meet again.
